architecture.kind: v9-body shape-parametric multi-scale conv U-Net (rdirect_unet.rs), CPU-trainable twin (rdirect_unet.rs::cpu)

doctrine_concordance: STAGE 2 of the v9-body lane: v8d's TIER1(estimator-init: NOT ported, no analytic estimator-init exists for a conv net yet — FRESH He-init instead, disclosed)+TIER2(K-averaged noise2noise, K={k_draws}, teacher=validator-only)+TIER3(structure: moving-camera history w/ REAL reprojection + curved-mirror/low-roughness pose + EMA history-source, kept as structural mechanisms, NOT the training signal) — same doctrine, whole-image conv body, plus v9c's own domain-fixed monitor + pose-diversity pool (this lane's own cure for the autopsy's train/val divergence + the fixed-camera-overfit diagnosis)
gate: NOT ordealed — v9c output only, no bar claimed passed
supersedes: rdirect-weights-v9b.bin (v9c = v9b + monitor domain fix + pose-diversity pool, see module doc)

training.domain_fix: settle()/run_monitor now undo_log_demod the final step's output (per-pixel albedo divisor) before every metric — same fix as rdirect_v9_eval_640.rs, ported back into the trainer's own in-loop monitor (scratch/v9-autopsy.md conviction #2)
training.highlight_recovery: same mechanism as K-averaged noise2noise (v8c/v8d doctrine) — NOT a separate loss term; highlight_ratio reported validator-only every epoch
training.history_precompute: once per epoch, sourced from EMA net (kept, cf8bd7b), whole-image conv forward per step
training.init: FRESH He-init (UnetWeights::new_random) — no conv-net analytic estimator-init exists yet, disclosed gap vs v8d's TIER1
training.loss: whole-image MSE(net(step features), mean of K=8 independent draw radiances) — teacher NEVER in the loss, validator only (v8d TIER2 doctrine, ported)

mirror_pose.note: curved-mirror/low-roughness pose, kept unconditionally FIXED (v8/A3-innocent parity) — NOT part of the diversity pool

moving_camera_settle.note: REAL reprojection via CamPose::reproject + depth/normal guard, NOT identity feedback — v8d parity

pose_diversity.note: orbit yaw in [-pool_orbit_deg,+pool_orbit_deg] about each anchor's pivot + small eye-position jitter box (±pool_jitter world units, vertical ×0.4), fresh draw every epoch — replaces v9b's 3 literal-fixed cameras (front/wide/orbit_+20)
